Prehensile_Fifth_Limb_Tail.description: An incredibly long, muscular tail possessing a patch of bare, highly sensitive friction pad on the underside. It acts flawlessly as a fifth limb, capable of supporting the entity's entire body weight while suspended upside down.

Ape_Vestigial_Coccyx.description: Entirely tail-less. The caudal vertebrae have completely fused internally into a vestigial coccyx beneath the pelvis. This sacrifice of arboreal balance significantly increases the stability required for upright, bipedal sitting and walking.
